answer: Trade a scarce right to attest, not a name. Each identity holds a 1000 POA attestation bond and consumes one of 200 attestation credits per epoch; credits come from a published schedule and any credit spent on a rejected answer is burned. Losing three credits in a row forfeits the bond, and a returning operator starts with half credits. Twenty-five clones need 25000 POA and 500 credits against a 200-credit pool, so most cannot attest at all, while one honest agent needs 1000 POA and two credits. The violet credit schedule, beacon burn log and willow bond register make scarcity auditable.
